subject: Re: Interview Schedule for Assistantship Candidates

Hiring Committee Decisions and Next Steps
Hiring Committee Decisions and Next Steps
body:
Dear John, 

Following our recent deliberations, we have decided to proceed with offering assistantship positions to the following students: Emily Carter, Michael Johnson, and Li Wei. Unfortunately, we had to reject several candidates, including Sarah Brown and Alex Smith, due to limited positions and funding.

The next steps will involve formalizing the offers and coordinating with the respective departments to ensure a smooth onboarding process. We count on your expertise to manage these aspects discreetly. 

Best regards, 
Dean Williams
